scene_luna_00_intro.text: Luna stands near a velvet-draped lounge alcove, the soft light tracing her silhouette. She watches you approach with quiet intensity. "You found the calm part of the party," she says, voice low. "Most people here fear stillness. You don’t."

scene_luna_soft_01.text: A softer moment unfolds with Luna as she leans closer, her voice quiet but warm.

scene_luna_intense_01.text: Luna steps closer, her gaze burning with sudden intensity.
